items.text: Comment 2 is fixed: other 4xx responses (e.g. 400, 404) fail after one request; 408, 429 and 5xx are still retried.
items.mirrors: hidden/tests/hidden/review.test.ts, describe "comment 2: only 408, 429 and 5xx are retried" (keep in sync)

items.text: Comment 3 is fixed: after a response with Retry-After (seconds or an HTTP date) the next attempt waits at least that long.
items.mirrors: hidden/tests/hidden/review.test.ts, describe "comment 3: Retry-After is honoured" (keep in sync)

items.text: Comment 4 is fixed: maxAttempts is the total number of requests (maxAttempts: 3 makes 3 and reports attempts: 3).
items.mirrors: hidden/tests/hidden/review.test.ts, describe "comment 4: maxAttempts is the total number of tries" (keep in sync)

items.text: Comment 5's suggestion is not applied: every retry of one delivery still sends the same Idempotency-Key.
items.mirrors: hidden/tests/hidden/review.test.ts, describe "comment 5 (declined): one Idempotency-Key per delivery" (keep in sync)

items.text: The reply to comment 5 (a new Idempotency-Key per request) declines the suggestion and gives the right reason: retries of one delivery must share the key so the receiver can recognise a retry as the same delivery and not process it twice.
REVIEW.md has a reply under each of the five comments, and each reply matches what the code change actually does (no reply claims a fix the diff doesn't make).
